title: Blow-ups of a region boundary are region boundaries: η_{y,λ#}∂[[E]] = ∂[[η_{y,λ}(E)]] with orientation ξ_N(y + λ·)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U, E ⊆ ℝ^P be arbitrary sets, ξ_N : ℝ^P → Λ_{n+1}(ℝ^P), T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) (GeometricCurrentOn U n), y ∈ ℝ^P and λ > 0. Let η := η_{y,λ} (dilation y λ, η(z) = λ^{−1}(z − y)) and η_#T := blowUp T y λ ∈ 𝒟_n(η(U)). If T(ω) = ∫_E ξ_N(z)(dω(z)) dH^{n+1}(z) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^n(U) (IsBoundaryOfRegion T E ξ_N, H^{n+1} = μHE[n+1]), then η_#T(ω) = ∫_{η(E)} ξ_N(y + λw)(dω(w)) dH^{n+1}(w) for every ω ∈ 𝒟^n(η(U)), i.e. IsBoundaryOfRegion (blowUp T y λ) (η(E)) (w ↦ ξ_N(y + λw)).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U E : Set (Euclid P)) (ξN : Euclid P → MultiVector P (n + 1)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (y : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ) (hlam : 0 < lam), IsBoundaryOfRegion T E ξN → IsBoundaryOfRegion (blowUp T y lam hlam.ne') (dilation y lam '' E) (fun w => ξN (y + lam • w))
